title: MOSE, Milan M4 and Venice gain connected infrastructure accounts
summary: Two projects and one municipal place connect barrier operations and rail access with local adaptation, waste collection and fleet renewal. Eligibility reaches 86 projects and 56 places, not a completed-portfolio total.
evidence_note: Sixteen official Italian HTML records inspected November 22 with traceable AI interpretation. Closure timing, allocations, institutional roles, operating rail scope, financing and local service stages retain their separate meanings.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
